### 2026-10-18 – Ok, so I finally finished adding the case and getting it to render correctly. The reason why it took so long was because the STEP file of my PCB that I was exporting from KiCad was NOT loading the par

**3.9h**

Ok, so I finally finished adding the case and getting it to render correctly. The reason why it took so long was because the STEP file of my PCB that I was exporting from KiCad was NOT loading the parts correctly, so I had to fix it like WAY too many times, and I found that I was importing the STEP files of the part inside of KiCad incorrectly, which leaded to it not exporting properly. I also spent some time trying to get the case to line up correctly, just to forget that I have another part that extrudes through the case, and I need to fix it. I put some renders below:

### 2026-10-18 – Well, I found out that my model was not alligned correctly.

**8.5h**

Well, I found out that my model was not alligned correctly.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 19.41.56](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/6854f713a853bdd9c959aefe573e6770488d8e9ce5653eccd35de1c4bce35665.png)

The for some reason, the PCB would not fit inside of the case, which was annoying but I found something even more annoying than that which was my case top DIDIN'T EVEN FIT!!!

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 19.43.03](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/685c0e9050cdcfcaab427f96956133891bafa7a10c294bc7fa1a989ad65a8a8b.png)

I had to redesign the entire thing which was annoying enough, but I still could not get it to fit properly!!! I was genuinley so confused, so I had to ask AI for some help here, and I asked if it could help find the problem with what I did wrong.

Well, turns out it was of course, a measurement problem. I was looking at the KiCad diagram incorrectly, and putting the measurements in Fusion wrong, so I just REDID THE ENTIRE PROJECT AGAINNN!!!

This time, I had much more knowledge (the power of youtube that I spent like 4 hours watching) and I made this:
